name: Render to video: every frame made, the same every time
description: A show with an Interactive Studio world, a 30 fps frame-numbered video on a row, a control line and a Screen FX block, rendered twice at 120 fps: the two files match frame for frame (GPU particle splats may differ by a few levels), and the video shows each of its frames exactly four times, in order, from its first.

steps.label: An Interactive Studio world over it, and a strip along the top for the video
steps.js: (async () => { const g = __show.g(); g.project.addLayer('World', 'interactive'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const id = g.project.addLayer('Strip', 'media'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); g.project.updateLayer(id, { corners: { topLeft: { x: 0, y: 1 }, topRight: { x: 1, y: 1 }, bottomLeft: { x: 0, y: 0.8 }, bottomRight: { x: 1, y: 0.8 } } }); return true; })()
